name: Milligan University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate for in-state and out-of-state. 2026-27 tuition & fees ($39,150 tuition + $1,950 fees = $41,100) from milligan.edu/admissions/tuition/. Standard on-campus housing (room only) $4,200/yr from the same tuition page (food/meal plan $4,550 separate). Note: the milligan.edu cost-of-attendance estimate page lists a slightly higher on-campus housing budget of $4,800; used the $4,200 standard published billable housing rate for room-only.
